parameters.name: NextHop
parameters.description:
The ID of the next hop connection.

> To query information about a prefix list that generates blackhole routes, set this parameter to **BlackHole**.

parameters.name: NextHopInstanceId
parameters.description: The network instance ID associated with the next hop connection.

parameters.name: NextHopType
parameters.description:
The next hop type. Valid values:

- **BlackHole**: queries information about prefix lists that generate blackhole routes.
- **VPC**: queries information about prefix lists whose next hop is a Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) connection.
- **VBR**: queries information about prefix lists whose next hop is a Virtual Border Router (VBR) connection.
- **TR**: queries information about prefix lists whose next hop is an inter-region connection.

parameters.name: OwnerUid
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the prefix list belongs.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the list to query. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: **100**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: PrefixListId
parameters.description: The ID of the prefix list.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the transit router instance.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status of the prefix list.

- **Active**: active.
- **Updating**: being updated.

parameters.name: TransitRouterTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the transit router route table.
